steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Are you all eavesdropping? Have you finished your work? Quit slacking off! Don't you know what the factory is going through right now?

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Oh right... What are we doing here again?

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Dumb Benna! To see Eve! Eve wants to stand up! To stand up!

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Shh... keep it down, don't disturb her.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Eve's found something she wants to work hard for... Good for her.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: You guys didn't tell her about the factory, did you?

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Of course not! Bass is smart! Bass didn't say anything!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: The bosses actually care about Eve a lot, right? They have been taking on such a big burden in silence.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: After all, she's their child...

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Mmmph!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Oh no, Mr. Benna, you said that word again...

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: What word, I don't remember...

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Child! Child! You can't mention child! Can't mention child in front of Maresa!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: ...Bass, stop talking!

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Child... child...

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: My child, have you seen my child? He was kidnapped! Have you seen him?

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Child, child...

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Maresa, calm down, it's us... Bass, go get the medicine!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Run, Bass! Run, Bass!

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Child, my child, my child...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: What happened? Why are you all gathered here?

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Nothing. Benna mentioned that word again. Bass went to get the medicine.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But... Bass is back already.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: So soon? Where's Maresa's medicine?

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: No medicine! There are bad guys, bad guys! Run, Eve!!!

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof... woof! Woof woof woof woof!
